segments.text: Trump says guilty verdict is a 'scar' on New York justice system, vows to 'keep fighting'
segments.explanation: By calling the guilty verdict a 'scar' on the New York justice system, Trump is attempting to evoke an emotional response rather than providing a substantive critique of the judicial process.

segments.text: The whole thing was rigged from day one — from the venue to the judge
segments.explanation: Trump claims the trial was 'rigged' without providing evidence to support this assertion, leading to a conclusion that is not substantiated by facts.

segments.text: But I've never had support like this.
segments.explanation: Trump appeals to the popularity of his support to validate his position without addressing the legal issues at hand.

segments.text: We couldn't get a fair trial
segments.explanation: Trump assumes the premise that the trial was unfair to prove the conclusion that the legal process was biased without providing evidence.

segments.text: We have a corrupt, Soros-backed DA — just think about what has happened to our country
segments.explanation: Trump attacks the DA by calling him 'corrupt' and 'Soros-backed' instead of addressing the actual evidence or arguments presented in the trial.

segments.text: Trump campaign spokeswoman Karoline Leavitt told Fox News Digital that 'crooked Joe Biden and the Democrats confined President Trump to a courtroom for more than eight hours a day for more than six weeks and he's still winning.'
segments.explanation: Leavitt shifts the focus to Biden and the Democrats' actions rather than addressing the specifics of the guilty verdict and the trial's evidence.

segments.text: 'Now that he is fully back on the campaign trial, Biden and the Democrats better buckle up,' she said.
segments.explanation: Leavitt uses a threatening tone to evoke fear or anticipation in supporters rather than discussing the legal case at hand.

segments.text: Trump 'generated billions of dollars in earned media coverage throughout the trial; hosted massive rallies and impromptu campaign stops in New York and beyond; increased his lead over crooked Joe Biden in the polls and raised more money than Biden and the Democrats in the month of April — not even a witch hunt trial could slow him down — in fact, it only made him stronger.'
segments.explanation: Leavitt focuses on positive outcomes for Trump and his campaign while ignoring the negative implications of the guilty verdict.

segments.text: This is a great scar on New York justice
segments.explanation: Trump's statement aims to invoke a sense of injustice and sympathy from the audience without addressing the legal basis for the verdict.
